reviews.text: Doesn't show aisle numbers. Pointless
Could not live without this app. Has completely changed my life and made meal planning so easy - and I also keep lists for so many different things.
Helps With Planning Meals Too!. AnyList has allowed me to organize our meals more efficiently and to not buy extra stuff at the grocery stores. My wife and I cannot get along without it.

Best Recipe and List App - Hands Down!. If you love getting recipes online, but hate scrolling through the story every time and trying to keep up with them - get this app! It’s worth every penny. Not to mention the shared lists for family collaboration. I love AnyList!
Best list thingy!. I have used this for grocery and recipes for years. I have something like 400 recipes in it and it’s probably my most used app after email and text. Love it.
I love this App. I use this for everything from a grocery list to a todo list. I even save all of my recipes here!

Best grocery list App. I have used this app to share a real time grocery list with my husband. Whenever either of us go shopping we can always count on the list being up to date. It keeps us on point- we only get what we need- ❤️
One of my favorites. I use AnyList every day and I don’t know what I would do without it!
Not just groceries. This is the best meal planner I have ever used. Love it!

The only app I pay for!. I’ve been using AnyList for over a decade. It is truly the best grocery, meal planning, recipe keeper app option there is! I’ve shared this app with countless friends and they’ve all ended up loving it as well. It’s truly the only app I have ever paid for. So worth it!

It’s great. My family uses AnyList for groceries, birthdays and so much more! Now it can lag sometimes but everything does, the one thing I love about it is you can add notes and instructions to your items! Thanks AnyList!!
The Best App Ever!. I have used this app for years now and each upgrade only makes it better! Customer service is always great! My whole family loves AnyList!

Essential. I’ve used AnyList for years now and it is the most essential app in my grocery/cooking arsenal. The recipe import is fantastic, the lists are easy to use, and it has an Apple Watch app for when I’m in the grocery store. It’s a great one stop shop for all things meal prep and cooking.
Been Using for Years. AnyList has been incredible and I’ve used for many years with my spouse. Watch app is great, syncing is solid, and instacart integration is awesome. Highly recommend.
Easy to save recipes. I love AnyList! Even if I find a recipe I can’t download, I can copy & paste with Create.

Any list Review. Been using for many years. Groceries Big Box Stores. Also Amazon
It’s been a great service!

Effective But Crude. Bought app to make it easier for shopping as a single elderly guy. Guess I “assumed” it would integrate with the grocery store shopping app already on my phone. It doesn’t. It’s nice but a technicality crude app that is reliant on everything web based and no compatibility with anything. “Support” is relatively good, but to be told it is incapable of doing what you bought it for should be stated in Apple Store’s App description. Cute useless app. More than a disappointment. This app has a very, Very Long way to go to be useful to me. I do wish them the best.
Great. Great app
Shopping list. Use almost every day
All purpose list. I make shopping lists, packing lists for trips and use the recipes function all the time!! Well worth a paid subscription! I love it and have used it for years.
Great app!. AnyList helps me so much. Importing recipes is super easy and using the meal planning feature and shared grocery list with my husband keeps us pretty organized.

The Best!. AnyList is the best app for storing recipes and making list of any kind!
Not only do I use it for grocery shopping, but monthly bills, Christmas list, party planning, and things to do around the house. 
And the fact that I can easily add items from a recipe to my grocery list is awesome. As well as being able to easily double or half recipes! 
Grocery shopping is so much easier now that I’m not carrying around a paper list and pen, just my phone which I do anyway. 
I can easily add items to my list throughout the week the arrange in order of the store layout depending on which Walmart I go too. This is the only app I am willing to pay an annual subscription for… and I don’t even use it to the full potential such as meal planning in the calendar.
Great App. I have used the premium version of this app for a few years now and it’s excellent. Love that the whole family shares the lists so whoever is at the store picks up everything we need.
A pleasure to use. Absolutely love this app. Intuitive and easy to use. The development team paid attention to the "small things" that make a huge difference in the user experience. Thank you!!

Organization Love. I have been using the AnyList app for quite some time (cannot even remember, it’s been that long 😁) and have found it to be incredibly helpful for organizing just about anything with lists. I’m completely OCD when it comes to organization and this app has so much to offer. I have multiple lists (e.g. grocery, packing, recipes, renovations, gifts, personal shopping, etc.) plus I’m always finding something else to make a new list for. The recipe import and meal planning is a tool everyone could use in their household. I’m totally ecstatic about finding this user-friendly AnyList app! Also, the creators behind this app have always responded to a question or suggestion I’ve sent (very personable unlike other apps I’ve used). I cannot say enough good things about them and the AnyList app! If you are in to organization, recipes and meal planning, this list is for you!

Fantastic app, great devs. We’ve used this app first as free users, then as paid subscribers for years. They’ve continued to improve it by adding a massive array of features while keeping the fantastic core functionality almost completely unchanged. I’ve been using the meal planning since they overhauled it, and it’s great and getting better. The company itself appears to have a lot of integrity, and they communicate well. Highly recommended.
Great App using it for years now. Love it recommend it all the time to family and friends. So many ways it can be customized to the way you want to cook

A Busy Mom’s Dream. It’s so easy to import recipes from Pinterest or the web. Then when we’re in the car driving to a game I can add the meals to the meal plan and add items to the grocery list. From the kitchen the family can use Alexa to easily add items to the grocery list (or other lists I’ve made). The hubs has even been known to to use the app to find out what’s for dinner and start cooking before I get home!
Great App. This app makes my shopping so much easier! It’s easy to use, makes it easy to keep lists at different stores and makes it easier to shop!
Love this app. I have had this app for several years and it is my favorite. I recommend it to everyone.

Saves me money. I’ve used this app for a couple years. It is a game changer, keeps me organized in the store. I love the recipe portion. I’ll be at the store and remember a recipe I’d like to try. It’s right there when I need it. I think it saves me money.

LOVE THIS APP!. This is one of the few apps I use religiously…. It’s easy and has all the options I need when shopping for anything from weekly groceries, to gifts and that never-ending To-Do list!! LOVE IT!!! 🙌🏼🥰
Sharing Capabilities. The sharing capabilities don’t work very well. Often the person I send it to doesn’t get a link.
Great for Collab. My husband purchased this app for us so we could plan meals around my new job, his job, our kids after school schedule, and our theater schedule.
My shopping assistant. So helpful and easily available! Easy to add all recipe ingredients… very handy tool!
Problem. I have lost all my stores and lists. I still have the app. It happened suddenly. How do I restore them?
Love this app. We use this for a lot of our lists. It comes in very handy.

Extremely useful. I have been using this app for many years, and have just watched it get more and more useful. I have all my major stores that I shop at, and throughout the week I will add items to it.

Using the AnyList for years!. I’ve used AnyList weekly for years, it was great to begin with, and it continues to improve over time. We organize our recipes, generate weekly grocery lists, and layout our meal calendar. Great value!
AnyList. An exceptional Application. Besides making a great shopping list, the recipe portion of the App is exceptional and truly shines. It is well worth the upgrade.

Perfect for our family. We share responsibilities therefore all family members have access to this app on their devices. It really enhances our communication of specific needs. Especially on our grocery list. 
This is our third year using the app. We are all very pleased.
Great Coordination. My husband and i use this app for many things. So convenient and easy! Use it daily.

Versatile!. The customizable fields let me make lists for everything with this app! Groceries, TV shows to watch (movies, current series, waiting for next season series), gifts to buy, gifts I’ve given, packing list for travel, endless possibilities!

I love this app. I have been using this app for years, and it is so helpful and convenient. It is easy to import recipes from virtually any site, and the shopping list tie in is so efficient and convenient. My husband has the app on his phone and he uses it when he is at the store. And he doesn’t like technology! I have bender had any issues, it keeps improving, and I am just so pleased! Thank you Anylist!

Stopped importing recipes. I really liked this app, and I even paid for it. I can’t get it to import from websites anymore, which was super handy. It’s been a minute since the function simply stopped working so I’m just copying my recipes by hand or into Notion before I delete the app.

Edit: After posting this review, it mysteriously started working again. 🙄
Excellent tool!. My family use it to manage our lists!
Better and better!. Just discovered the linked timers. Brilliant.

The BEST! This is a must buy all in one app!. Everything in one app to plan, buy, create, store recipes and more! And it’s so intuitive and easy.
My family has been using this app for years. It just gets better and better. Creators must be chefs or great cooks to think of all the add-ons over the years. It is by far my most used app and is a must have!

Use daily. This is probably my favorite app and one of my most frequently used apps! I love checklists and it is so nice to have all my lists stored in one spot (that can’t be lost on paper). I equally love the recipe and meal prep sections. It is so easy to transfer recipes onto the app and love being able to organize how I want. Meal planning has become a breeze. I really appreciate that lists can be set for groceries and automatically sort into categories as I enter items. I have my teenage kids using the app and introduced it to extended family members as well. Everyone loves it!

Could be great, but it’s missing things like priority (1-5 or some such, not just yes, no). I love the Alexa integration and it works very well... except for things like V8 which always comes out on the list as v eight. :-)
Great App. This app is easy to use and easy to customize. It has so many uses. Give it a try!

Super Useful List app. I have been using this app for years. I have grocery lists, I have hardware store lists, I have packing lists for vacations. I even used it to manage the to-do's for my house renovation! You can sync lists with other people, you can share via email or text message. You can customize the look, everything you need! And the developers are super responsive when you have a question or an issue. It's all I need. Also, the calendar feature for scheduling meals is super convenient and helpful for keeping of what ingredients I need and when.

Update: still using this app as much as ever. Very helpful for organizing recipes, grocery lists, and meal planning, as well as general lists like packing lists or hardware store lists or party planning. The new calendar features are phenomenal, helping to keep a running list of meals we like so that I don’t have to come with recipes on my own. The queue and Ideas pages are super quick and helpful.

My favorite App!. I have used AnyList for several years - so this is a real review. I love the grocery list, once built with all my typical and seasonal purchases I have been making my grocery lists in just moments each week. I also love keeping all my recipes and easily uploading new ones. The ability to double or half a recipe is another plus. Finally, as avid RVers I have all our camping lists, packing, food staples, menus/recipes, set up and tear down routines, and seasonal maintenance steps. 
If I could give the app a perfect 10 I would!

Recent cross off. It would be very nice to be able to see recent cross offs as sometimes items get tapped in error and the show cross offs bring everything back. Just a thought from a long term lover of this app.

Easy to use and maintain. Worth it. Spent some time experimenting with data entry and found the app to be very intuitive and easy to use. I use the app in conjunction with a hard copy “post-it” list on the refrigerator where we family members capture items as they are needed, then quickly adding to the app when it’s time to roll to the store to make certain nothing is forgotten. The app’s organization makes it very efficient while shopping while in the store.

The ultimate list making app. my girlfriend turned me onto this app about a year ago. And now I don’t do anything without it. I’m a Capricorn and if you know anything about my sign, we are anal when it comes to organization and structure. And there’s no better way to organize and structure to do list Than with this app. I have it on my phone and I have it on my Mac MacBook Pro. It’s dispensable. I simply cannot live without it.

Use Anylist for everything!. This keeps me and my hubby in synch for all kinds of lists. We manage all shopping lists, packing lists for various destinations, even track our NFL game schedules! Highly recommend. Having issues synching with Alexa right now but I am sure that will be fixed.

The best list and recipe app!. Update: Still using it after several years now. I love the fairly new meal queue feature. There isn’t a day goes by that I don’t open this app at least 5 times.

I’ve been using AnyList Complete for a little over a year now and I can’t imagine ever using anything else to manage my recipes and grocery lists. It is so powerful with the way you can import recipes and add your own recipes, then being able to just touch ingredients and have them added to your list, AND you can make other types of lists. I’ve tried Copy Me That and it’s a bit clunky compared to AnyList. 
I do wish there was a meal plan set feature like CMT though. In CMT you can create reusable meal plans without assigning them to a specific date. You can make meal plans with Anylist Complete but you must assign the menu to a date and while you can move the meal to a different date, I would like to have a menu “bank” that I can go to and see them all together without having to scroll through the calendar. Maybe they’ll get to that in a future update.

Awesome App!. It’s so easy to set up shopping lists and upload recipes that I use frequently…the recipes always there, even when I’m at relatives’ homes and cooking for them, or traveling in our RV. AnyList makes building a shopping list for any kind of store (grocery, big box store, hardware, etc.) very easy and helps me plan a week’s menu and list needed ingredients quickly and easily. Have been using this app over 5 years and they keep improving it in response to user requests. I recommend you try it, then subscribe…many powerful features!

Love this app, great for Husbands!. I love that I can share this with my husband. As a homemaker, it’s nice to have a grocery list we can share so if my husband wants to stop on his way home from work he knows what I need . And because of the item photos he can get the EXACT item without having to guess or feel stress that he’s not getting the correct item!

We love it!. I have used this for three years, and for once I even got my husband to use a grocery app! But, I use it for SO MUCH MORE! We keep lists for house projects, packing for different places we travel, and for the different towns we visit to shop so we can consult the list for all the “the next time we go to ____, get this”. Thanks for making it so simple to use but so many features! It is SO simple to add recipes from websites that we have a ton!
Best app for me !!. This saves me so much time. I use the grocery list constantly.

Don’t limit what you can do. I not only have a grocery list, I have a very complete camping list and emergency prep list (tornado watch/warning)
This app is very handy and customizable.
Best. I have been using AnyList since it’s inception. Is perfect for shopping, meal prep, recipes all in one place. I highly recommend.

Shares with Amazon. They shared all of my information to Amazon. I pulled up my shopping list on Amazon to see all of my AnyList lists inside. How is that for privacy. Thank you for selling my information. Maybe they sent me a notification with an email to cover their tail but now Amazon has my lists even random lists. Do. Not Use. Do Not Trust.

Update: AnyList sent me a message telling me that it’s my fault that they shared with Amazon because I’ve been a faithful user of AnyList for too many years. That’s why I’ve cancelled.

Thanks. This is a great app and what I appreciate the most is every time I’ve send a text, somebody replies in short order. In addition to that, they continually make updates that improve the app. Cheers, and great job guys.

Awesome time-saver!. I love this app! It is so feature-rich 🤩 not only does it save me a ton of time at the grocery store, but I love that I can easily import my recipes from online to keep them in one place and edit them to save changes I personally made to the recipe for future use! 
It’s also really helpful to be able to add items directly from my recipe into my shopping list! 
Highly recommend!
Easy to use. I have had the AnyList app for at least 3-4 if not 5 years. It’s just so easy to use works with my alexia very nice

Best List or To Do App Ever!. If I could tell you how many years and how many apps and how many systems I’ve tried for list making I’m not sure you would believe me. This is the best app I’ve ever come across. It’s the BEST system from the recipe grabber and its functionality, to the neat way you can cross things off a list, (which seems like a simple thing, but it’s very satisfying). Please always keep this app going!

3-year household subscriber 👋🏼. My favorite organization-slash-productivity app, hands down. And this is coming from a productivity junkie/former productivity app hoarder.

We are unwavering, loyal 3-year household subscribers. New features are rolled out regularly and it’s always updated. Doesn’t skip a beat with every what seems like weekly iOS update. 

Aside from shopping lists, my husband and I have used it for everything from vacation planning to keeping track of movies/shows we need to stream. We even used it to plan our wedding last summer. It also works and syncs seamlessly between my iPhone and his Android (been trying to convert him for ~11 years of coupledom…sigh…no dice😒). 

I love that I can opt to keep lists private too e.g. gifts for him to keep the element of surprise. One of these years, he’ll get an iPhone wrapped in a bow.

Importing recipes is criminally effortless, including custom recipes I create with ChatGPT. How’s that for a use case 😉

I could go on but I’ve got some to-dos to tackle. But at least I know where to start🤓

Awesome shopping organizer. My wife and I put the shopping list together each week. I normally do the food shopping. 

Easy and fast to add items to an AnyList. We each have a copy of the app on our phone and the list is shared between us. If my wife has an item to add while I am shopping she adds it and I see the new item in our Anylist on my phone. BIG time saver. Also good for our monthly Costco run. Add items over the weeks as we see we will need them. Great app! Lots of uses.

Most used app. I've enjoyed AnyList for several years and find it to be my most-used app over my devices. It is reliable and extremely useful. I do wish that all web sites would use the format that AL uses (Cooks' Illustrated, for example). When a website doesn't support the format, I leave the site immediately. I also wish there was some way to import PDFs, but that's most likely impossible. Thank you for an absolutely beautiful app!
Don’t know what I’d do without this!. This is the most useful app I’ve ever subscribed to, I use it every day

This app is a MUST HAVE!. I'm a very busy person who works for myself running a private concierge company. 

AnyList manages my entire life and I could not live my busy life without it. 

I have thousands of recipes on hand at my fingertips, the ease of adding the ingredients to the grocery list and then the further ease of ordering from the stores through the list and just transferring things from the grocery list. It's just amazing how practical it is.

Further, I manage all of my lists on here: I have a list for my supplements and medications that I take now ready for any healthcare professional that needs it. 

I have a to-do list. 

I have my bucket list. 

I have a list for what I take when I go on vacation.

Just download it! you will not understand how you managed your life before.

Amazing grocery list. By far the best app I’ve found for putting together lists that both me and my wife can use and see. The integration with my Walmart+ makes shopping so easy. I will use this app for as long as it’s around.

Could not live without AnyList!. I have been using AnyList for at least five years and it very quickly became a part of my daily life. I have innumerable lists that have made life much easier with my busy schedule.

That said, I think the best part of this app is the recipe function. I can bring recipes from the web directly into AnyList, with a very high degree of accuracy, most of the time 100%. I use the meal planning function all the time, and from planned dishes, I create a shopping list by simply tapping on the ingredients I need to purchase. When it comes time to cook, the recipes I want to make at the time are in one place on today’s date. I also have planned meals show up in my Google Calendar automatically. 
I also also use the recipe “Collections” function, which makes it easy for me to find recipes and plan meals. My two sisters and several of my friends also have the app, so we send each other recipe files that are installed from an email directly into the app without having to do any typing.

If you are a busy person, this app is wonderful. If you are also a chef or wannabe chef, this app is essential. Without question, it’s the best $10 per year that I spend on apps.

Our family loves this app!!. We’re a household of 3 adults and 2 kids. Mom, Dad, Grandma rotate who cooks and plans dinner and this has been an absolute blessing of an app. We always know what is needed - not just for meals but for anything else. We tell everyone about this app and couldn’t recommend it more. Thank you AnyList team!!

Best app I own. This is my favorite app. The grocery list alone is fantastic with customizable categories and stores, but the meal planning, queue for ideas, and calendar is fantastic. SOOOOO worth the subscription price. I use it for all my lists, books I want to read, movies I want to watch, things I need to do, typical restaurant orders for takeout…. If I have a list, AnyList is where I keep it

No customer support!. I’ve actually been using this app (paid subscription) for YEARS. Until I got a new phone and could not get logged back in. I’ve used the same email address but the app kept saying could not locate that account. I reached out not once, not twice but 3 times via email with no response! After about a month of trying to get logged in ( because all of my recipes were saved there) I gave up. This is my last ditch effort to gain access to my account and get some sort of support!

I LOVE this app!. This has to be one of the best apps I have on my phone. I’ve have AnyList for must be close to a decade and I’m constantly amazed at all the new updates that keep making it better and better! I tell everyone about this app because it’s so useful, affordable, and easy to use. Thank you so much for constantly improving this app (even though I never think it needs improving but you continue to amaze!)

Great app!. My family has been using this app for several years now and love how easy it is to store and recipes as well as grocery lists. Our adult children living in their own house and it’s fun to see what they cook and try their imported recipes as well. Favorite feature is that if I add something to grocery list when my husband is already going to store, it notifies him that the list was modified, prompting him to look at list again even if he thought he had gotten everything. Highly recommend!

Fits my needs perfectly. I love that I am able to share my app with my husband and granddaughter. I’ve been using this app for a few years now and each upgrade. It has been right on the only problem I’ve ever had is with trying to import recipes and that was probably my fault.
Must be seven years.. I have utilize this for five of my favorite list one even for keeping track of everything needed for an oil change on my car at home.
Love this App. I’ve been using this app for years and absolutely love it! So easy to use and something I can’t live without!

New timer feature is very handy!. Also like the recipe queue section. I can add recipes I want fix without having to choose a date to prepare. 
I have used this app for many years and each update is better and better!

Love this app. Have been using for years and love this app. Have all my lists, from grocery, Costco, pharmacy to things I need to bring on vacation. Completely customizable. I download all the online recipes I like with a few clicks. Totally worth the annual fee.
Found nothing better. This is the very best user friendly shopping list I have found. We have been using it for years. Highly recommended!

GREAT App. I have used and paid for this App for many years. If 2 people are doing the shopping it is great for not double buying. Remove an item from your list and it is removed from the list of whoever you are sharing with.

Good for other lists also. Share or make private!
Love this app. Love this app. The whole family has access and can add their items to the list-so efficient. Love the integration between the meal planning, recipes and grocery list.

Use it almost every day!. Initially used this as the free app but the paid version has become so useful- lists, halving or doubling recipes, noting on calendar when you’ve made it. When traveling have all my recipes with me. And the import from the web feature is da bomb!

Best Shopping list app. This is the best shopping app you can get it almost never crashes and you can have your whole family add groceries in list. It even works with kids that cant read well but can speak add it to list.

A Must-have Organizer. I use this multiple times a day. I have customized shopping lists for everything from groceries to sewing needs to hardware. I have travel packing lists which I “duplicate”, remand, and modify to meet the needs of a specific trip. The recipe section is amazing. I have downloaded many recipes from the web and added in my own. I love that I can add items to my grocery list from the recipe view. I use the calendar and “Queue” (recipes I want to do sometime) daily. Highly recommend.
Worth the price!. I love it! The AnyList app is perfect to organize my gifting guides, recipes, etc.

It's a lot more than a grocery list app. This is one of my most-used apps. It's easy to use and customize-let me create many lists for various purposes and configure each one the way I like. I like that I can share lists with other family members so they can add and cross off things. The web interface is very handy when I'm working on my desktop. And it's very reliable--no crashes, lost data, no long outages when it won't connect to cloud storage (that was what made me switch from my last list app).
Frequent shopper. Love that you can upload pictures of what you’re looking for at the grocery store. Also, I love the ability for the multiple lists and recipes.

Keeps my house organized.. My wife and I have been using this app for years & wouldn’t know what to do without it. Makes grocery shopping lists a breeze. Syncing it with Amazon was a game changer as well.

Insanely Robust and user friendly. I am more dependent on this app than I am on anything else on my phone, or perhaps more Bradley my life in general. My recipes all reside on here, which I used to populate my grocery list, in addition to work things to do list and personal things to do list and innumerable other lists. And I also rely heavily on the inter on the web-based AnyList, which synchronize the seamlessly with the app on my phone. A lot of love and attention was put into this solution. It is well worth the annual fee for the premium addition.

The best around. This is my most used app on my phone, and I can’t sing its praises enough. We bought an annual subscription and it’s so worth it. Plus, every new feature is so thoughtful and actually useful! I’m so grateful for this tool.

AnyList is a great everyday resource. We’ve been using AnyList for years. It is a great resource for storing, searching and using recipes. It also makes grocery shopping more efficient. We use Alexa to add items to a shopping list at the moment we realize we need replenish an item while in the process of cooking. No more forgetting an item when shopping!

You need to create an account to use. It’s a grocery list app. I was hoping to use to make shopping easier, I am very forgetful. 

It seems wholly unnecessary for every app now adays to require you to sign up, give them all your information. It’s a grocery list, it’s not that deep.
Love it!!. I’ve used AnyList for years!! So helpful when an item I need can be added at my fingertips!

AnyList. This app is great. In my family we have list for many retail, home logistical and restaurants. We use the app to communicate grocery and home improvement items. When we think of something we put it on the list and when we go to the store we don’t forget anything. Keep up the great work! Texas Slack~R

Review. 5 +++++ It’s the only App where you get back money for shopping at there Store Just scan your receipt and it will pay you thru Pay Pal Just scan your receipt at any Store like Grocery Store’s and ext , Some Stores aren’t available it depends on Your location . Just read about the app and you will be pleased you did . 😊
AnyList is an essential app. We use AnyList for shopping, & packing Camping checklists for leaving town, arriving at camp, putting our camper away. We love, AnyList.

Can’t live without it. My wife and I have been longtime users of this app. It keeps getting better and better. The team behind it is super friendly and responsive. The pricing for complete is more than fair. 

I love to go shopping with the shopping list on my Apple Watch and to see our meal plan for the week in my regular calendar. 

It’s also great for things like packing lists or to organize the shopping for a multi-family get away.

Update 2026: can’t believe how well those timers are implemented. Pure joy! 👍🤗
Close to perfect app. Seriously, this does everything I want a list-making app to do. I can share it with my spouse, schedule meals, assign stores, change categories. It’s exactly what I need.
Excellent. Been using for several years. My husband initially found this app. So convenient and easy.

Complex App & Sluggish Support. I tried to like this app, I really tried. But 3-4 weeks after paying the $15/year to share lists with my husband & get “prioritized support,” I still have no idea what I’m doing in the app (haven’t even shared with my husband yet since he knows even less about this stuff than I do), and the support is strictly via email only. By the time I get replies to my emailed questions, usually days later, I forgot what my questions even meant, and have even more questions. The powers-that-be need to hire people to chat online and take phone calls. I’m still at a stalemate, because I need someone to walk me through different topics in real time so that I can understand the moves and why. If you are tech-savvy enough to understand the filters and category sets, you’ll probably enjoy this app. As for me? I’m not there yet. Doubtful at this point whether I ever will be. Two stars. Maybe.
The older I get the more I need and use AnyList. The older I get, the harder AnyList works. So convenient, don’t have to stop to write down or try recall some foggy idea I needed something
So useful. I cant believe how useful this is, its changed my attitude towards cooking, and the best part is theyre always adding features and the technology works great.

Efficiency unlocked!. I have been using AnyList for many years, and now I share it with my daughter away at college. The recipe integration, recipe downloading, pricing tool, meal planning and now recipe sharing are really incredible!!

The ability to categorize List items (and to arrange the categories according to the aisle layout of our local grocery store) means whoever is doing the shopping can do a single pass through the store (without having to “double back” for a forgotten item). 

The “Favorites” list allows you to easily add frequently purchased items to the List, by simply selecting them.

You can attach a photo of an individual grocery item, making specific (or infrequently-purchased items) easier to identify. 

AnyList also allows you to do your grocery shopping online. (It will transmit your shopping list to your local grocery store, and you can go pick-up your completed order when it’s ready.)

The ability to store prices of individual items means you can keep track of how much you’ve put into your cart, as you go. (The total is updated every time you check an item off - avoiding sticker shock at checkout.). 

The ability to upload recipes into AnyList (from a number of Web sites) is a great feature. After uploading a recipe, you can add individual ingredients to the Grocery list with one tap. (AnyList will show which recipe each ingredient is needed for, and how much of it is required for that recipe.) 
Recipes can be organized (within AnyList), so you can easily retrieve them.

You can also do meal planning in AnyList, by assigning recipes to specific dates on an internal Calendar.

Periodic updates add additional features.

AnyList is extremely powerful and easy-to-use.
